Charles Schwab, the largest U.S. retail brokerage, announced on November 9 that its Schwab Crypto platform has added spot trading for Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK), bringing its supported assets to five alongside BTC and ETH. Elliptic: North Korean Hackers Create Meme Tokens on NEAR to Launder Binance Hack Funds

Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic reported that North Korean hackers are creating meme tokens and using DEX liquidity pools to launder funds stolen in the $6.4 billion Binance hack. Between November 5 and 7, the attackers created at least six meme tokens on NEAR, each costing around $90 to launch, and routed approximately 117,000 NEAR ($430,000) through the pools to complicate fund tracing. Elliptic previously identified a similar technique in the laundering of funds stolen in the 2025 Bybit hack. — link

BitMine Nears 5% of ETH Supply After Adding 9,587 ETH

BitMine said it acquired 9,587 ETH over the past week, bringing total holdings to 6,070,092 ETH, or about 4.97% of Ethereum’s supply. The company has 5,227,037 ETH staked and said fully staking its ETH holdings could generate about $359 million in annualized rewards at its trailing seven-day staking yield of 2.65%. Total crypto, cash, marketable securities and other investments stand at about $14.3 billion. — link

Avalanche to Serve as Core Ledger for NYSE-Affiliated Tokenized Securities Platform

Ava Labs said Avalanche will provide the core blockchain ledger technology for clearing and settlement on an upcoming tokenized securities platform affiliated with the New York Stock Exchange. The platform is designed to support 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized equities issued across multiple blockchains, subject to regulatory approval. — link

Coinbase wins final OCC approval for national trust bank charter

Coinbase has received final approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for its national trust bank charter, following conditional approval in April. The charter will support the company’s crypto custody, payments and potential stablecoin issuance or administration activities, but does not allow it to take ordinary deposits or make loans like a traditional commercial bank. — link

Binance Says Alleged 335M-User Data Leak Likely a Scam

@BinanceHelpDesk said it is investigating claims that ShinyHunters stole data on 335 million users and demanded $900,000, but has found no evidence that its systems, KYC data, account credentials or wallet private keys were compromised. The exchange said parts of the listing are inconsistent with how Binance stores user data and that the dataset may instead involve infostealer data taken from users’ own devices. — link

Nvidia CEO Affair Fallout: Binance NVDAUSDT Drops 4.2% vs Last US Close, Volume and Open Interest Rank No. 1 Among Top 8 Platforms

Binance Research said management-related uncertainty at Nvidia emerged over the weekend. With US stocks closed, Binance’s NVDAUSDT perpetual contract briefly traded 4.2% below Nvidia’s previous US close. Over the past 24 hours, Binance’s Nvidia perpetual recorded $360.35 million in volume and $90.57 million in open interest, ranking first in both among the top eight platforms it tracks, accounting for 44% and 30.1% respectively.
